candidate: Claude Design Field Guide v2.1.3; private reader-history-cleanup final-r2
reviewScope: Independent PDF visual and editorial-layout review of frozen final-r2 outputs. No edits to builder or candidate, no Git, network, browser, Figma, publication, or new interaction testing.

roleInventory.note: Automatic dense-table labels on pages 51 and 52 do not describe the actual rendered roles. This review used every page and records the actual dense tables separately.

inspectionMethod: All four whole-book contact sheets were inspected first. Every physical page was then inspected in native 144 dpi 2-by-2 proof sheets for both rendering engines and both appearances. Pixel comparison verified all 216 original page images appear unchanged in these inspected sheets, without resampling or cropping.
observations: No clipping, overlapping elements, footer collisions, missing images, or caption overflow was observed in either appearance or renderer.
All nine original chapter drawings remain readable. Separately authored dark drawings retain legible detail against the Late night background; screenshots retain their authentic light UI.
Chapter 8 now gives current source-component, text-style and variable restoration guidance without the dated construction paragraphs or technical node-count history.

The Figma answer-key caption and body explicitly identify editable Review and Cart frames with no prototype connections or choice-state wiring. They require wiring and testing before being treated as interactive.

The current-material scope distinguishes React and offline cart behavior from static Figma frames and the recorded native Design screenshots. The cart caption describes the current configured item without dated correction chronology.
The guided exercise still explicitly requires human review and a completion record. Removing the author-specific review-status sentence does not assert that a human review occurred.
Dense tables wrap within their columns. The page 31 to 32 transition table repeats its header and retains a body row before the break.
Changelog is one terminal page, physical page 54 and printed label 48, and its contents entry uses label 48. Its concise entries preserve correction scope and avoid construction counts.
Sparse checkpoint pages and screenshot viewport crops are consistent with the retained layout/assets; this review found no new missing-content or PDF clipping defect.
